common_flavor_assumptions.C1_scope: Real top-only charged-scalar LO dipoles, ms=0; no full Zee matching claim
limitations: Operator bridge passes only for the retained real top-only LO dipoles; frozen upstream contract metadata is historical.
The explicit MSbar top mass is an input; this diagnostic performs no running, conversion or calibration.
Quadratic new-physics Wilson terms, additional operators, NP NLO/NNLO and finite-ms effects are omitted.
SM 0.14e-4 error is NOT a derived Zee BSM theory uncertainty.
No covariance or justified scan-point exclusion/acceptance; not a physical BR prediction.
Do not impose the single-state Type-II 2HDM 670 GeV lower mass bound separately on Zee charged scalars.

matching_card.provenance: Frozen C1/C2 HyperIso 1.0.3 reference LHA 984391031656a5f4f86ee71f5b60e7d0cb2b1b80edabd9ff6ba912da3ba39374; module5/BSGAMMA_2026_ACCURACY.md. Explicit reference input, no running or recalibration to 2026 SM.

common_flavor_assumptions.method_robustness_reason: No new EOS/SuperIso/NLO variants executed; legacy method spread is not an NP sigma.

reference_comparison.assumptions: Symmetric Gaussian quoted SM and experimental errors; rho=0; no NP error. Reference sensitivity only, not a Zee likelihood or validated 95% CL test.

compact_view_note: Full gate/decay/family records remain in dataset_path with dataset_sha256. Gate detail hashes use module14.scan.digest canonical JSON. Complete scalar cards are retained here.

final_local_adapter_crosscheck.note: AF Python 3.9 versus local Python 3.10 math rounding; these numerical tolerances do not define physical accuracy.
